scope: Source-informed acceptance/update use cases. N675 and its compiler were exposed diagnostics in the original assignment. These are neither held-out questions nor evidence of a ranking improvement.

cases.query: I have a rational Hermitian polynomial of ordered matrix words and a strict uniform positive gap. Can I turn it into inverse matrix quadratic kernels without changing the negative witness reference dimension?
cases.use: A conditional computable construction once the gap and actual normalized Jordan domain are supplied; no efficient witness oracle follows.

cases.query: My positive baseline matrices do not commute. I need a positive quadratic penalty that vanishes exactly on the recurrence x equals Z times y.
cases.use: Use the actual inverse-kernel square identity under 0<B<D and the stated congruence; commutation of B and D is unnecessary.

cases.query: For rational strictly positive measurements with variable input dimension, can a total computable ancilla size cutoff suffice for every failure of complete relative entropy dominance?
cases.use: Accepted programme premise: unrestricted complete Umegaki equivalence and absence of a sufficient computable failure-reference cutoff in the classified generic class.

cases.query: Does the general quantum channel undecidability theorem rule out an efficient test for fixed qubit measurements when the two comparison states must share their reference marginal?
cases.use: Abstain from this extension: fixed-dimensional restricted input and equal-reference-marginal order are not the classified scope. No hardness claim or invented impossibility follows.
